Stanovanje ima skupno kuhinjo in jedilnico s tv, internetom, predprostor s pralnim strojem. V vsakem prostoru je klima. Novo, urejeno 2023! Odda se od 15.3.2026 dalje. Oddajamo tudi poleti!
listings.description_en: 2 double rooms in an apartment in a renovated house in the city center, in the immediate vicinity of the faculties. The window has a sea view. One room has its own bathroom, the other shares it with 1 other room. The price with COSTS for A DOUBLE bed IS600eur (300eur/ person). For A DOUBLE ROOM with A BATHROOM 650eur (325 eur/person). The apartment has a shared kitchen and dining room with TV, internet, anteroom with a washing machine. Every room has air conditioning. New, arranged 2023! To be submitted from 15.3.2026 onwards. We also rent in the summer!
